label: Terminate instance infra
description: Delete one instance's copy of a `@per_instance` infra node and its disk. The instance's triggers reading it go down per `triggers`; its runs follow `running`.

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: The `@per_instance` infra node, named as the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance id your program gives it (`user-42`).

inputs.name: triggers
inputs.label: Triggers
inputs.description: The instance's triggers reading it: park queues what arrives, hibernate keeps accepting for `graceMinutes`, wipe drops it.

inputs.name: running
inputs.label: Running work
inputs.description: The instance's runs still going: wait lets them finish, cancel stops them. `wipe` needs cancel.

inputs.name: graceMinutes
inputs.label: Grace minutes
inputs.description: Hibernate only: how long it keeps accepting.

inputs.name: includeSelf
inputs.label: Stop this run too
inputs.description: On: this run is cancelled too when it is one of the runs reached.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the triggers reading the copy are down and the delete is handed off; the copy is deleted afterwards.

then.message: TerminateInstanceInfra '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no infra node of this program marked `@per_instance`. Name one the way the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).
TerminateInstanceInfra '{id}' wipes the triggers but lets running work finish. Wiping drops what the runs still need, so set `running` to cancel, or pick park or hibernate for `triggers`.
